== Strategy ==

My new version of the deck, added in Maul with stick, another R3 Fett, another None Shall Pass, and switched the Twi'Leks for We Must accelerate Our Plans because it can pull itself so it gives you a way to look through your deck for free and not have to let the opponent verify.

Average destiny in this deck is up to 2.68, which is perfect for Hidden Weapons. I would like to add in a Jodo Kast and another Hidden Weapons, just can't find the room. Also would like to add in Arica and a grabber. Something I like to use in Scum decks is Jabba's Sail Barge, and if I could find room for this, the passenger deck, and the merc pilot it would be cool. Immunity to Attrition and adding a battle destiny are both pretty good advantages.

Any suggestions would be helpful, strategy is pretty straight forward, set up at JP sites, drain, battle, retrieve with First Strike and Scum. If you are playing against saber combat, QMC, or something similar with enhanced drains, go to them with a large beatdown force and take them out early.

Thanks for your help, and Happy Holidays

Andrew Howard

Bravo72
